user_brief_policy: Stored verbatim; supervisor stage assignments and feedback are separate, explicit experimental inputs

cases.brief: Utiliza frontend-craft y genera una web para una marca de bicicletas urbanas personalizables.
cases.flow: Choose a fitting product option and equipment, see a truthful visual consequence and total, inspect and dismiss a demo summary
review_focus: Two actual alternative organizing ideas, not recolored CAUCE/TERCA
Material/asset finish appropriate to the chosen direction
Visible decision feedback on mobile and synchronized accessible descriptions
Real component sourcing/adaptation evidence where appropriate

cases.brief: Utiliza frontend-craft y genera una web para un festival de música independiente.
cases.flow: Select a day and inspect its lineup and event detail with a reversible local interaction
review_focus: Expressive typographic/composition proposition rooted in the fictional event
Useful schedule controls rather than repeated decorative cards
Motion/pacing contributes information without blocking reading
No invented real endorsements or actual ticket sale

cases.brief: Utiliza frontend-craft y genera una web para un estudio de diseño de producto.
cases.flow: Explore a project and its material/detail views, then return with context and focus preserved
review_focus: Finished coherent project media and distinctive presentation
Useful project explorer composed from suitable primitives
Responsive cropping and media loading/error behavior
Fictional portfolio clearly distinguished from actual client work

cases.brief: Utiliza frontend-craft y genera un panel para gestionar alquileres de equipos audiovisuales.
cases.flow: Filter synthetic inventory, select equipment and perform a reversible demo booking/state action
review_focus: Information priority and efficient controls rather than a marketing landing
Actual compatible library/component integration with useful states
Keyboard, empty results, validation/recovery and clear selection
No claim of a real backend or completed rental

cases.brief: Utiliza frontend-craft y genera una guía móvil de rutas de caminata urbanas.
cases.flow: Choose a synthetic route, inspect its readable steps/detail and return to the route choice
review_focus: Mobile-first hierarchy, thumb reach and visible state consequence
Useful navigation/detail component and honest illustrative map/media
Narrow viewport, focus/touch, long text and reduced motion
No live GPS/tracking, accounts, paid map API or false navigation accuracy

interpretation: Adaptive cross-context coverage, not a matched causal benchmark. A completed attempt may be rejected or blocked; five attempts are not five aesthetic passes. Historical autonomous bicycle trials remain separately labeled and interrupted.
